changes.name: OrbSpawnGuard
changes.source:
local world=workspace:WaitForChild("GrowIslandWorld")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")

local function blocked(orb)
 local params=OverlapParams.new()
 params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 params.FilterDescendantsInstances={orb}
 local hits=workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(orb.CFrame,Vector3.new(5,7,5),params)
 for _,hit in ipairs(hits) do
  if hit:IsA("BasePart") and hit.CanCollide then
   local n=hit.Name
   if n~="StarterIsland" and n~="IslandEarth" and n~="Expansion1" and n~="Expansion2" and n~="TreasureIsland" and n~="Bridge" then
    return true
   end
  end
 end
 return false
end

local function safePosition()
 for _=1,80 do
  local pos=Vector3.new(math.random(-20,20),22,math.random(-20,20))
  local probe=Instance.new("Part")
  probe.Name="OrbSpawnProbe";probe.Size=Vector3.new(2.2,2.2,2.2);probe.Position=pos;probe.Anchored=true;probe.CanCollide=false;probe.Transparency=1;probe.Parent=world
  local bad=blocked(probe)
  probe:Destroy()
  if not bad then return pos end
 end
 return nil
end

local function protect(orb)
 if not orb:IsA("BasePart") or orb.Name~="EnergyOrb" then return end
 task.defer(function()
  if not orb.Parent then return end
  if blocked(orb) then
   local pos=safePosition()
   if pos then orb.Position=pos else orb:Destroy() end
  end
 end)
end

for _,v in ipairs(world:GetChildren()) do protect(v) end
world.ChildAdded:Connect(protect)

task.spawn(function()
 while world.Parent do
  for _,v in ipairs(world:GetChildren()) do
   if v:IsA("BasePart") and v.Name=="EnergyOrb" and blocked(v) then
    local pos=safePosition()
    if pos then v.Position=pos else v:Destroy() end
   end
  end
  task.wait(.5)
 end
end)

print("Orb spawn collision guard loaded")
